name: Premier Inn Christchurch/Highcliffe
accommodation: Double, twin, family and accessible rooms
beachAccess: About a five-minute drive to Highcliffe Beach
overview: A chain hotel about five minutes' drive from Highcliffe Beach and Highcliffe Castle, with Avon Beach also under ten minutes away. Rooms include doubles, twins and family rooms, and there is a restaurant on site.
surfTripFit: A low-cost base with parking, a short drive from both Highcliffe and Avon beaches.
